en_title: 'Appreciate the Fans' — GTA 5 Cast Tell Jason and Lucia’s Actors the Most Important Things They Should Know Before GTA 6 Launches Them to Fame
subtitle: 「真心珍惜粉丝」
opus_summary: 《GTA5》主演与CJ配音演员为《GTA6》两位主角的演员分享建议：享受过程，听取Rockstar的意见，并做好成名准备。Ned Luke强调，必须真诚珍惜粉丝。

paragraphs.en: The stars behind GTA 5’s Franklin, Michael, and Trevor, along with the voice of CJ from San Andreas, were asked if they had any advice for the actors playing GTA 6’s Jason and Lucia now that the game is almost here.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》即将发售，有人向《GTA5》中富兰克林、麦克和崔佛的饰演者，以及《圣安地列斯》中CJ的配音演员提问：他们有什么建议想送给饰演《GTA6》主角杰森和露西亚的演员？

paragraphs.en: The long wait for GTA 6 is almost over. After 13 years, the game is finally set to release on November 19 in one of the biggest (and potentially most expensive) pop culture moments in history.
paragraphs.cn: 对《GTA6》的漫长等待即将结束。时隔13年，这款游戏终于定于11月19日发售，将成为流行文化史上规模最大的盛事之一，也可能是耗资最高的盛事之一。

paragraphs.en: Knowing just how passionate Rockstar’s fanbase can be, actors who starred in previous games in the franchise shared their words of wisdom with the as-yet unannounced actors who are playing Jason and Lucia, the dual protagonists of GTA 6, in an interview with All Out Gaming at MCM Comic Con.
paragraphs.cn: 系列前作的主演们深知Rockstar的粉丝有多热情。在MCM漫展接受All Out Gaming采访时，他们向《GTA6》双主角杰森和露西亚的饰演者分享了经验，而这两位演员的身份尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: “Have fun,” CJ’s actor, Young Maylay, said.
paragraphs.cn: CJ的饰演者Young Maylay说：「好好享受。」

paragraphs.en: “To be honest, just listen to what Rockstar says,” Shawn ‘Solo’ Fonteno, famous for playing Franklin in GTA 5, added. “They’re gonna lead you in the right direction. … But get ready. That’s all I can say, is get ready. It’s a ride that they’re gonna be on for a while.”
paragraphs.cn: 因在《GTA5》中饰演富兰克林而闻名的Shawn「Solo」Fonteno补充道：「说实话，听Rockstar的就好。他们会指引你走对方向。……不过，要做好准备。我能说的只有这一句：做好准备。这段旅程够他们走上一阵子了。」

paragraphs.en: Young Maylay continued, remarking on how the GTA games have garnered dedicated fanbases from multiple generations of players. “We’ll always be the characters that we are, and for the generation of kids who are coming up, you’re gonna have certain brackets,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: Young Maylay接着谈到，《GTA》系列如何吸引了一代又一代忠实玩家。他说：「我们永远都会是各自饰演的角色，而随着新一代孩子长大，粉丝也会分成不同的年龄层。」

paragraphs.en: “Right now, I got all the OGs. Everybody coming in my line — you catch some youngsters, but you got guys with the grey hair coming in saying, ‘Hey man! You’re the guy, CJ!’ And they [gesturing to the GTA 5 cast] have all the youngsters right now. So, during this time period, you’re gonna grow with your fanbase. It’s not like everything’s gonna get shut down by you guys [speaking of GTA 6]… we’ll always be those characters, and you can’t take that from us.”
paragraphs.cn: 「现在，老玩家都在我这边。来我这里排队的人里，虽然也有一些年轻人，但也有头发花白的人过来说：你好啊！你就是CJ！而他们［指向《GTA5》的演员们］现在吸引的都是年轻人。所以，在这段时间里，你会和自己的粉丝一起成长。不是说你们［指《GTA6》］一来，我们这边就全都结束了……我们永远都是那些角色，这一点谁也夺不走。」

paragraphs.en: Ned Luke, who played Michael De Santa in GTA 5 , urged the upcoming stars to be grateful for the game’s fans. “Just make sure that you appreciate the fans. Let the fans know… fake appreciation, they can smell it. You have to really appreciate them, genuinely, because what we have is because of them. If you don’t have the fans, you don’t got nothin’. They’re the game, and that’s the bottom line,” he imparted.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA5》中饰演麦克·迪圣塔的Ned Luke叮嘱即将成名的两位演员，要感激游戏的粉丝。他说道：「一定要珍惜粉丝，让他们知道你的心意……假惺惺的感激，他们一眼就能看穿。你必须真心实意地感激他们，因为我们拥有的一切都是他们给的。没有粉丝，你就什么都没有。他们才是游戏的根本，说到底就是这么回事。」

paragraphs.en: The cast's warm sentiments toward GTA fans is at odds with one particular star in the franchise: Steven Ogg, who infamously said he felt "nothing inside" regarding GTA 6 because he's "not a gamer" and has "never played a video game" before. That being said, he did suggest killing off his character at the beginning of GTA 6 as a means of "passing the torch" to the next era. "I think that would be cool, because it also acknowledges the fans of like, 'Hey, thank you.' Pass the torch, stomp Trevor's head in, and sort of put an end to that and allow a new generation to take over," he mused back in 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 这些演员对《GTA》粉丝的热情，与系列另一位主演Steven Ogg的态度形成了反差。他曾说，自己对《GTA6》「内心毫无波澜」，因为他「不是玩家」，而且「从没玩过电子游戏」，这番话引发过争议。不过，他确实建议过在《GTA6》开头杀死自己饰演的角色，以此向下一个时代「传递火炬」。他在2025年曾设想：「我觉得那样会很酷，因为这也是在向粉丝致意，跟他们道一声感谢。把火炬传下去，踩烂崔佛的脑袋，算是为这一切画上句号，让新一代接棒。」

paragraphs.en: Thus far, the actors who play Jason and Lucia have not been officially announced, though fans are extremely convinced that they’ve discovered the gal who lent her facial features to Jason’s partner in crime. Fans suspect she will be played by an actress named Manni L. Perez , as she has the exact same voice and bears a strong resemblance with the GTA protagonist. (For her part, she’s been very careful to honor her supposed NDA, if she really is involved in the project.)
paragraphs.cn: 截至目前，官方尚未公布杰森和露西亚的饰演者，不过粉丝们十分确信，自己已经找到了为杰森这位犯罪搭档提供面部形象的女演员。粉丝怀疑露西亚由一位名叫Manni L. Perez的演员饰演，因为她的声音与这位《GTA》主角完全一致，长相也十分相似。（至于她本人，如果她确实参与了这个项目，那么她一直非常谨慎地遵守着那份可能存在的保密协议。）

paragraphs.en: The fervor around GTA 6 is at an all-time high. Rockstar is ramping up marketing for the title in a major way with a Vice City-themed takeover of Miami that includes massive signs advertising the fictional city, even partnering with the Miami Heat to give the team some Vice City uniforms for their November 18 game against the Milwaukee Bucks. Players will even get a chance to eat at one of the game’s fast food joints , Burger Shot, at the Kaseya Center while they watch the two teams face off on the court.
paragraphs.cn: 围绕《GTA6》的热情已达到前所未有的高度。Rockstar正大幅加大宣传力度，让罪恶都市主题宣传遍布迈阿密，包括为这座虚构城市设置巨幅广告牌，甚至与迈阿密热火队合作，为球队提供罪恶都市主题球衣，供他们在11月18日对阵密尔沃基雄鹿队时穿着。玩家甚至有机会在卡西亚中心一边观看两队交锋，一边在游戏中的快餐店Burger Shot用餐。
